Story.solutionLead: SafeBite helps highlight possible milk-related terms in seconds.
Story.solutionBody: The main scan works directly on your phone. No internet is needed to read the label, and product photos are not uploaded for analysis.

InfoSection.aplvDescription: CMPA is an immune reaction to proteins found in cow’s milk, such as casein and whey. It is different from lactose intolerance.
InfoSection.ingredientsBody:
• Cow's milk (in all forms)
• Casein and Caseinates
• Whey
• Lactose (may contain traces)
• Cream, Butter, Cheese, Yogurt
• Annatto extract (sometimes contains milk)
InfoSection.shoppingBody:
• ALWAYS read the label, even if you already know the product.
• Look for the phrase 'Contains: Milk' at the bottom of the list.
• Beware of cross-contamination ('May contain...', 'Processed on equipment...').
• Prefer foods with certified 'Vegan' or 'Dairy-Free' seals.
InfoSection.resourcesBody:
• Substitutes: Almond, soy, rice, oat milk.
• Calcium: Broccoli, spinach, almonds, fortified tofu.
• For cooking: Use coconut oil or vegetable margarine instead of butter.
InfoSection.severeSymptoms: For severe symptoms such as difficulty breathing, swelling of the tongue or throat, or faintness, follow your medical emergency plan and contact emergency services immediately.
InfoSection.epinephrineNotice: If epinephrine has been prescribed, follow your doctor’s instructions and call emergency services immediately.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At SafeBite, we value your privacy and the security of your information. This policy describes how we handle your data in our mobile application.
Privacy.designBody: SafeBite's core feature is its ability to process information locally. Label scanning is performed entirely on your device. Your images are never sent to our servers or third parties for analysis.
Privacy.collectionBody:
We collect only the data needed to operate the app features you use.
• Account Data: Email and profile details when you create an account.
• Scan History: Saved product review data for authenticated history and household sync.
• Diagnostic Data: Crash and error logs.
• Usage Data: Technical information about app interactions and ads.
Privacy.cameraBody: SafeBite requests permission to use the camera solely for scanning labels. We do not save photos to your gallery without permission.
Privacy.thirdPartyBody: We use Google ML Kit for local text recognition, Supabase for account and sync features, RevenueCat for subscriptions, Firebase for analytics and crash diagnostics, and Google Mobile Ads for rewarded ads.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can clear history, manage your account, restore purchases, or request account deletion from the app settings.
Privacy.disclaimerBody: SafeBite is an informational tool. It is not a medical device. Always physically verify labels.
